getStarted.title: How will you use Driplare AI?
getStarted.subtitle: Choose the setup that fits you. You can change your workspace later.
getStarted.personalDescription: Explore Driplare AI and manage your own AI workspace.
getStarted.businessDescription: Set up your business workspace, AI agents, and customer channels.

auth.visualEyebrow: AI that works for your business
auth.visualDescription: Bring your customer conversations and AI workflows together in one clear workspace.
auth.personalNote: Start with a personal workspace. You can add a business workspace anytime.
auth.businessNote: Your business workspace will be created after you finish setting up your account.

clerk.signInSubtitle: Sign in to continue to your workspace.
clerk.signUpSubtitle: Create your free account to get started.

business.title: Let’s set up your business
business.subtitle: A few quick details will help us tailor your workspace.
business.categoryTitle: What kind of business do you run?
business.categoryRequired: Choose a business type to continue.
business.categoryDescription: Choose the closest match. You can update it later.
business.nameRequired: Enter your business name to continue.
business.nameDescription: This will be the name of your workspace.
business.zoneTitle: What should we call your business area?
business.zoneDescription: This optional label helps organize the records you manage.
business.logoDescription: A logo helps your team recognize this workspace. You can skip this for now.
business.logoHint: Optional. PNG or JPG works best.
business.storageError: We couldn’t save your setup in this browser session. Please enable session storage and try again.
business.invalidDraft: Your saved setup could not be read. Please review your details and continue again.
business.logoError: We couldn’t read that image. Please try another file.
business.logoTooLarge: Choose an image smaller than 10 MB.
business.completeDescription: Your account is ready. We’re creating your business workspace now.
business.completeErrorTitle: We couldn’t finish your workspace setup
business.completeErrorDescription: Your business details are still saved in this browser. Try again, or return to review them.
business.missingDetails: Your business setup details are missing. Please complete the setup again.
